Red Planet:Mars
A pair of twin rovers were sent here, they lasted 40x their estimated lifespan
Has a canyon that would span from Arizona-North Carolina on Earth
The tallest known mountain in the solar system is here


Orange Planet:Saturn
While multiple planets have rings, this planet's are reflective due to a thin layer of ice
Least dense planet, could float in a bathtub (if you had one big enough)
While not the biggest planet, it has the most moons



Purple Planet: Venus
Hottest planet in the solar system 
Has a thick atmosphere, making it extemely difficult to photograph
Lots of volcanic activity


Blue Planet: Uranus
Rotates on its side
Predictions show diamond rain due to high levels of methane
It's blue is due to methane, which is poisonous, unlike Earth's water blue


Green Planet:Earth
Our home!
The most hospitable planet in the solar system due to the Goldilock's Zone
Planet with the most manmade orbiting objects


Pink Planet:Dwarf Planets
Like pluto, these are technically orbital bodies, not planets
classification is dependent on size of celestial boodies surrounding them
We actually have five! Pluto, Ceres, Haumea, Makemake, Eris
